content:
maria-devex: Quick check — I'm adding request-id propagation to the streaming client. Two things I'm wondering about:
1) preferred header name for cross-service tracing (we currently have several variants in infra)
2) how folks map API error payloads to SDK exceptions for streaming vs normal RPCs (we need typed exceptions for 401/429/5xx and also application-level error codes inside stream events).

@todd-sdks: For header I'd vote for `x-rd-request-id` (consistent with our other infra prefixes) and mirror it to logs. For mapping: keep a small error registry in the SDK keyed by `error.code` from the JSON body, fall back to HTTP status mapping. E.g. `AuthorizationError` for 401, `RateLimitError` for 429, `TransientServerError` for 5xx.

todd-sdks: Example mapping snippet we use in node client: 
```js
function mapError(resp, body) {
  const rid = resp.headers['x-rd-request-id'] || body?.request_id;
  if (resp.status === 401) return new AuthorizationError(body.message, rid);
  if (resp.status === 429) return new RateLimitError(body.message, rid, body.retry_after);
  if (resp.status >= 500) return new TransientServerError(body.message, rid);
  if (body && body.error && ERROR_REGISTRY[body.error.code]) {
    return new ERROR_REGISTRY[body.error.code](body.error.message, rid);
  }
  return new ApiError(body.message || 'unknown', rid);
}
```

alin-frontend: For streaming you'll also see application-level errors inside the stream frames (we emit a `control` frame with `{type: 'error', code: 'MODEL_NOT_FOUND', message: '...'}` before closing). The client should map those to exceptions the same way, but the tricky part is resume tokens: make sure the request-id you log is the one from the original start request, not a reconnect-generated id.

jess-eng: On logging: please include `req_id` as a structured field in every log line and surface it in debug logs. Example log lines we recommend: 
```
INFO 2026-04-12T15:12:01Z client/stream start req_id=abc123 model=gpt-4-mini
DEBUG 2026-04-12T15:12:05Z client/stream recv-frame req_id=abc123 frame_type=chunk seq=42
WARN 2026-04-12T15:12:06Z client/stream control err req_id=abc123 code=MODEL_NOT_FOUND message="..."
ERROR 2026-04-12T15:12:06Z client/stream closed req_id=abc123 reason=control_error
```
Include the request-id in metrics/tagging too so infra can correlate traces.

sam-infra: A couple infra notes:
- We already attach `x-rd-request-id` at the edge when missing, so SDKs should prefer server header if present.
- For retries: only retry on `TransientServerError` and socket/connect timeouts; do NOT retry on application-level `control` errors unless they explicitly say `retryable: true`.

maria-devex: Nice, that covers a lot. Two followups: 1) should the SDK expose a typed hierarchy (classes) or just error codes on a single ApiError? 2) how to include the original stream frame payload when throwing so callers can inspect it for debugging?

todd-sdks: We expose a small class hierarchy. Most apps `catch (err instanceof RateLimitError)` etc. Also attach `err.requestId` and `err.raw` where `raw` contains the original body/frame. Example: `new RateLimitError(msg, rid, {retryAfter, raw: body})`. Keep raw optional to avoid blowing up logs by default.

jess-eng: For JS/TS SDKs expose types: `interface ApiError { name: string; message: string; requestId?: string; raw?: any; retryAfter?: number }` so users can pattern-match without `instanceof` if they want.

alin-frontend: One more streaming quirk — on reconnect we send `resume_token`. If the server returns `resume_not_supported`, surface a `ResumeNotSupportedError` with the original requestId to help debugging.

ci-bot: test-failure: streaming-auth-test failing in CI, stack points to `mapError` not including header fallback.

maria-devex: I'll take the CI fix and PR a small utility `extractRequestId(resp, body)` + update mapError to attach raw frames. Will include unit tests for control-frame mapping. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

todd-sdks: Ping me on the PR and I'll do a quick review.

sam-infra: If you want, we can add a short integration test in infra that asserts `x-rd-request-id` is echoed back in logs for a streaming session.

maria-devex: That would be great. I'll open a follow-up ticket for infra tests.
